changes: Test worker scheduling query and test Flow observation moved from 0.1s to 1s; test API used INFO rather than inherited DEBUG. Required worker init/cleanup correctness fixes also landed before the successor. Product metadata and record data polling cadence were unchanged.
limits: The baseline and successor are different implementation/fixture versions; this is not a single-variable causal benchmark.
Per-request latency and production resource/throughput limits were not measured.
Empty/end-of-stream and unaccepted retry reads can change consumer-read request counts; accepted append/complete durability was not inferred from counts.
5000-record deadline must be chosen from measured phases with explicit headroom; it is not a throughput SLO.
